items.title: Slovakia's Fico says country will not join proposed €45 billion EU loan for Ukraine
items.summary: Slovak Prime Minister Robert Fico said Slovakia intends to stay out of a proposed €45 billion EU loan for Ukraine, as it did with an earlier €90 billion loan. He argued that Ukraine would be unable to repay the money and accused others of tying the financing debate to negotiations over the EU's 2028–2034 budget.
